sentences.text: Page No.# 2/3
By this petition under Section 439 Cr.P.C., the accused-petitioner, namely, Smti.
Ramecha Khatun, has prayed for grant of bail in connection with Sivasagar P.S. Case No.117/2023 under Sections 342/366(A)/376 of the IPC, r/w Section 6 of the POCSO Act.
It is noticed that the accused petitioner has been in judicial custody since 12.08.2023, i.e. for 90 days.
The matter relates to kidnapping and commission of rape on a minor victim girl by the petitioner's son.
The accused petitioner, who is the mother of the FIR named accused, wrongfully confined the minor victim.
Perusal of the case dairy, including the statements recorded u/s 161 and 164 Cr.P.C., it is seen that there is prima facie implicating material against the petitioner.

However, in the overall backdrop of facts and evidence, as emerged from the case diary and having considered the length of detention, this Court is of the considered opinion that further continuation of detention of the accused, in the interest of investigation, is not warranted.

Accordingly, it is provided that the accused petitioner, named above, shall be released on bail of Rs.
40,000/- with one surety of like amount to the satisfaction of the learned Special Judge (POCSO),
Sivasagar subject to the following conditions- i) That the accused petitioner shall cooperate with the Investigating Officer as and when required; and ii) That the accused petitioner shall not directly or indirectly Page No.# 3/3 make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Police Officer or the Court.
Breach of any of the above conditions of bail shall render cancellation of the bail in accordance with law.
Return the case diary.
This disposes of the bail application.
